reference_sql:
WITH order_units AS (
  -- one row per order placed from 3 to 9 March 2025 (UTC days of order_ts): its units, added up before any join
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00')
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(u.units) AS units
FROM order_units u
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = u.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
alternatives:
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code

WITH week_orders AS (
  -- one row per order placed from 3 to 9 March 2025 (UTC): only the columns the report needs
  SELECT order_id, store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
), order_units AS (
  -- one row per such order: its units
  SELECT w.order_id, w.store_id, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
  FROM week_orders w
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = w.order_id
  GROUP BY w.order_id, w.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(u.units) AS units
FROM order_units u
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = u.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code

other_way.sql:
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code
other_way.tradeoff: Joining first and counting distinct orders gives the same numbers, but every line is carried through the joins first.

solver.query:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(u.units) AS units
FROM orders o
JOIN u ON u.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10'
GROUP BY s.store_code
